data.brand.name: subsel
data.brand.tagline: A connected commerce platform — storefront, fulfilment, hub network and last mile in one operating system.
data.home.headline: Considered goods, delivered precisely.
data.home.subtext: Apparel, electronics, accessories and home objects — picked, packed and tracked through our own fulfilment network.
data.home.fulfilTitle: Every parcel is scanned, not guessed.
data.home.fulfilText: Orders split automatically across our Chennai and Thanjavur fulfilment centres. Each package carries a unique QR that is verified at pick, pack, hub intake and handover.

post.description: Scans item SKU barcode, confirms packing, prints QR label, or hands over to first hub.
Scans parcel QR: 1st scan = received, 2nd = sorted, 3rd = dispatched / rider assigned.

200.description: Active deliveries, return pickups, and cash to collect

post.description: Confirms delivery by scanning parcel QR, verifying 4-digit customer OTP, and recording COD cash.
Generates signed params for uploading product photos and media assets.
